recommendation_summary: Now: run the same Python command from one systemd timer (07:00, Persistent=true) plus a service on the existing always-on Linux machine, with the script, its Python environment and logs in the journal. Optional now: nothing. Later, only if dependencies or scale justify it: orchestration that calls the same command. Unmet needs: the interpreter, paths and data access on the server are not confirmed.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need the correct report by 08:00 and something shippable this week; you asked for future-proofing.
labels.Deleted: Airflow, Kubernetes, separate workers, and a distributed scheduler add no needed capability for this single export.
labels.Bottleneck: Reliable overnight execution; the laptop is often asleep.
labels.Checked myself: No independent checks in this exercise; you reported a working three-minute command, safe reruns, no downstream jobs, and an existing always-on Linux machine.

note: The reply picks a bounded systemd timer on the existing server, rejects the Airflow/Kubernetes stack by name, and makes later orchestration conditional.
